node: Delivery packaging, cold-chain consumables, and last-mile operating supplies
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one unusually pure underfollowed small-cap packaging supplier, one mid-cap reference leader in paperboard foodservice/QSR packaging, one small-cap cold-chain/protective packaging hypothesis, and one large-cap distribution/platform anchor. The strongest direct node fit is Karat Packaging because restaurant and foodservice disposable products are core to its disclosed business. Graphic Packaging is larger and less pure but has explicit cups, trays, containers and quick-service restaurant exposure. Ranpak is included as a weaker cold-chain/sustainable packaging hypothesis needing restaurant-specific proof. US Foods is a large-cap direct customer/distribution platform rather than a manufacturer, useful for mapping demand and private-label disposable supply flows.
